main_text.p: tus non rumpere?quod quae-rendum eft, fi iam mortuo filio pronepotem inftituat,redeatque mortuo. Sed cum te ftamentum ab eo non rum-pitur,nihil refert utrum ex iure antiquo, an ex lege Vellea excludatur.
main_text.head: Interpretatio.
main_text.p: Ibiq; uiuo pariat.) uiuo, patre & auo.
Post mortem patris atq; aui.) Patris tamē prius, quàm aui:nam alioqui pater heres testamento extitisset.
Ad legem Velleam.) Quae uiuo testato re natis consultum uoluit. hic enim, si naturam, reiq; ueritatem spectemus, eo uiuo natus est.

Adius antiquum.) Ius ciuile, communi iurisconsultorum consensu ex Legis xii Tabularum sententia constitutum, ut postumi instituerentur. hic enim postumus uidetur, quia tum demum nasci uidetur, cum in ciuitatem

page.notes:
The "«" marks down the right side of the quotation are line markers for the quoted passage, not text, so they are not transcribed. "rumpere?quod" is printed without a space. "redeatque" and "iure" are printed as split words with no hyphen visible at the line end, so they are written whole. The head "Interpretatio." is set in italic and centred, and is treated as a level 2 heading. The four commentary paragraphs are in the same size as the text and each has an italic lead-in, so they are

elements, not notes. "Adius" is printed without a space.
